items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-24
items.q: we can look back at those 20 movies with Doris Day or whatever

ctx.x: All I knew was the music.

Okay. Now, let me ask, let me ask you this. If we make an analogy between his music and a kind of a romantic stock image, would it be fair to say that the romantic image of the two people on the balcony is pretty much a cliche dated image? In other words, we can look back at those 20 movies with Doris Day or whatever and say, well, this is a genre of the 20s. And we can sort of all partake in them and enjoy them because, well, we know that they're of a certain time and place and we enjoy it. But it's dated and a…
See, I wish it were dated, John, but I really think that a large section of Americans still hold that image.
